# agent-copy fixtures

Rows as herdr drew them in a real pane, beside the reply the agent had saved, captured 2026-09-17 for `#hrdr-8`.
`*.rows` is the pane's text, one drawn row per line, with the agent's own gutter intact.
`*.reply.json` carries the pane width, the agent's saved reply, and the text a correct copy produces.
`codex-108-tool-rows.rows` is a tool cell, which must copy unchanged.
`codex-108-lists.*` covers bullet and numbered items whose wrapped rows carry four spaces of display indentation.
